actual_checks: Full exact prompt, wrappers/meta, report/source/author records and entire earlier exploration read. The prior establishes an abstract full-support sufficient condition and finite races; the added content is the precise published GRH plus joint grand-simplicity theorem giving every full ordering positive logarithmic density, with an exact leader-density translation.

The stated hypothesis excludes central zero ordinates, repeated ordinates and rational linear relations among the nonnegative primitive-family zero ordinates, stronger than individual simplicity. Source assumptions are kept conditional and fixed-modulus. No unconditional or finite-race inference is made.

For r=phi(b), the (r-1)! full strict orderings with chosen leader are disjoint; their union differs from strict leadership only where some other counts tie. Source limiting measure is absolutely continuous on the sum-zero hyperplane when r=phi(b), so the finite tie-hyperplane union has zero mass/density. Sum of ordering densities gives a positive leader density and all leader densities sum to one without asserting they are equal.

Positive logarithmic density forces unbounded winning cutoffs. Taking integer parts preserves all prime counts and strict inequalities. Nonreduced classes only contain prime divisors of b and have bounded counts; Dirichlet makes reduced counts unbounded. b=1 is vacuous and b=2 eventually settled directly. The exact simultaneous comparison in the literal prompt is retained.
